LanguageData.CAC_ModeTitle: How do you want to make your colonists?
LanguageData.CAC_ModeSubtitle: You can pick your scenario, storyteller and world next, as usual.
LanguageData.CAC_ModeNormalDesc: The standard RimWorld character screen: roll random colonists until you like them.
LanguageData.CAC_ModeCreatorDesc: Design every colonist and pet yourself: personality, looks, genes, clothes, gear and relationships.
LanguageData.CAC_PlayTip: Start the colony with this group.
LanguageData.CAC_ConfirmBack: Go back to the previous page? Going back makes the game generate new starting colonists, so the colonists you made here will be lost (save any you want to keep to the gallery first).
LanguageData.CAC_AddFromGalleryFull: Add colonist from gallery (group is full)
LanguageData.CAC_HoverForDetails: Point at an option to see what it does.
LanguageData.CAC_MustDoNote: Only show backstories and traits that leave all of these available. This is remembered for next time.
LanguageData.CAC_TabDesc_Appearance: Gender, age, body, head, hair, beard, tattoos, skin, hair and eye colour.
LanguageData.CAC_TabDesc_Inventory: Weapon, carried items and the colony's starting supplies.
LanguageData.CAC_TabDesc_Relationships: Family, partners and pet bonds within your group.
LanguageData.CAC_TabDesc_Ideoligion: What this colonist believes, and how strongly.
LanguageData.CAC_TabDesc_Health: Old injuries, missing body parts, prosthetics, implants, conditions and addictions.
LanguageData.CAC_TooYoungForAdulthood: Colonists get an adult backstory at age {0}.
LanguageData.CAC_SkillsNote: Skill levels come from the backstories and traits you pick. Click a flame to raise the passion and right-click to lower it: none, interested, burning. Click a level to type your own number (0–20).
LanguageData.CAC_PassionTip: Passion: {0}\nClick to raise, right-click to lower.
LanguageData.CAC_AgeTip: Biological age: how old their body is. Type a number or use the arrows, up to {0}.
LanguageData.CAC_AgeChronoTip: Chronological age: years since they were born, counting time in cryptosleep. Never less than their biological age.
LanguageData.CAC_LockTab: Lock this tab: what's here is kept when you press "{0}".
LanguageData.CAC_UnlockTab: Locked: what's here is kept when you press "{0}". Click to unlock.
LanguageData.CAC_ChildNote: Children can't do every job and grow up over time.
LanguageData.CAC_EyeColourNote: Eye colours come from genes, including any your other mods add. Some modded eye genes do more than change colour, so point at one to see everything it does.
LanguageData.CAC_HealthNote: Everything here is in place when the colony starts. Prosthetics and implants are free, and nothing that would kill the colonist can be added.
LanguageData.CAC_ScarDesc: A healed injury that left a permanent scar. Some scars still hurt now and then.
LanguageData.CAC_MissingPartDesc: Starts the game without the {0}. A prosthetic can replace it later.
LanguageData.CAC_WontTakeDrugs: {0} won't take drugs, because of a trait or their ideoligion.
LanguageData.CAC_CouldNotAdd: Couldn't add {0}. The colonist may already have it everywhere it can go.
LanguageData.CAC_NothingToAdd: There's nothing of this kind that can be added right now.
LanguageData.CAC_CertaintyNote: How firmly {0} believes. The lower it is, the easier it is for others to convert them.
LanguageData.CAC_ColonyIdeoNote: When the game starts, the ideoligion most of your colonists follow becomes the colony's main one, just as it would during play. Colonists who believe in something else keep their own ideoligion.
LanguageData.CAC_NoSavedIdeos: You don't have any saved ideoligions yet. You can save one from the ideoligion editor when you start a colony.
LanguageData.CAC_CarriedNote: What this colonist carries in their pockets and pack. The weight limit is the game's own, so body size, genes and mods that change carrying all count.
LanguageData.CAC_WeightTip: The game's own carry limit for this colonist. Worn clothes and weapon: {0}. Inventory: {1}.
LanguageData.CAC_TooHeavyToAdd: Too heavy. {0} has {1} of room left.
LanguageData.CAC_OverWeight: {0} is carrying {1} too much, maybe because of heavier clothes or a weapon. Remove something, or the extra will arrive next to them when the colony starts.
LanguageData.CAC_ArrivesNextTo: These don't fit in {0}'s inventory, so they'll arrive next to them when the colony starts:
LanguageData.CAC_SuppliesNote: Shared starting supplies from the "{0}" scenario. Change amounts, add or remove anything. Shift-click +/- for 10, Ctrl-click for 100.
LanguageData.CAC_ResetSuppliesConfirm: Put the colony supplies back to the scenario's original list?
LanguageData.CAC_RelationsNote: How {0} is related to the rest of your group. Pick a relationship from each dropdown.
LanguageData.CAC_NoOneElse: Add more colonists to give them relationships.
LanguageData.CAC_FamilyOutsideNote: Relatives who aren't joining. They may turn up later in the game.
LanguageData.CAC_BondNote: A bonded pet follows its master and is trained to obey. Pick who {0} is bonded to.
LanguageData.CAC_OpenGallery: Gallery: load a saved colonist or colony
LanguageData.CAC_GalleryEmpty: No saved colonists yet. Use the save button above a colonist to add one.
LanguageData.CAC_OverwritePreset: A saved colonist called "{0}" already exists. Replace it?
LanguageData.CAC_SaveMenuTip: Save to gallery: this colonist or the whole colony
LanguageData.CAC_OverwriteColony: A saved colony called "{0}" already exists. Replace it?
LanguageData.CAC_GalleryNoColonies: No saved colonies yet. Use the save button above a colonist and choose "Save the whole colony".
LanguageData.CAC_LoadColonyConfirm: Replace your current colonists, pets and colony supplies with "{0}"?
LanguageData.CAC_ColonyTooBig: That colony has {0} colonists, but this start allows {1}. Only the first {1} were loaded.
LanguageData.CAC_SkillLevelTip: Click the number to type a level (0–20). Enter keeps it, Escape cancels.
LanguageData.CAC_ManualSkillsTip: On once you type a level in. Backstory, trait, age and xenotype changes then leave this colonist's skill levels as they are.
LanguageData.CAC_RecalculateSkillsTip: Work this colonist's skill levels out from their backstories and traits again, replacing the ones you typed.
LanguageData.CAC_FaNoStyles: Facial Animation has no styles of this kind for this colonist.
LanguageData.CAC_FaEyeColourNote: Iris colour is set on the Colours tab.
LanguageData.CAC_AddFromGeneticsFull: Add colonist from genetics (group is full)
LanguageData.CAC_GeneticsNote: Choose how the new colonist is related to your colonists. Their genes come from those relatives.
LanguageData.CAC_GeneticsSavedParent: Add a saved colonist as a parent...
LanguageData.CAC_GeneticsFailed: This colonist couldn't be made. The log has the details.
LanguageData.CAC_TooYoungToBeParent: {0} is too young to be a parent.
LanguageData.CAC_TwoParentsMax: A colonist can only have two parents.
LanguageData.CAC_SiblingOrParents: Siblings share their parents, so choose a sibling or parents, not both.
LanguageData.CAC_NoAgeFits: No age fits: a parent must be at least {0} years older than their child.
LanguageData.CAC_HasThatParent: {0} already has that parent in your group.
LanguageData.CAC_NeedsGrownUp: A colony needs someone aged {0} or older.
LanguageData.CAC_BabyNote: Babies have no backstory or traits yet. They get them as they grow up.
